messages:
maria: Reminder — external assessment scheduled Tue morning. Need clear remediation SLA, rollback/rollforward playbook, and who owns evidence bundling + log snapshots. Also KMS access questions.

sam: Contractual SLA is 72h for P1. I'll draft rollback playbook (hotfix + emergency rollback). Who will prepare the evidence bundle we hand over?

eva: I'll prepare the bundle. Plan: create timeboxed read-only S3 bucket, issue ephemeral STS credentials scoped to that bucket, and provide a presigned object for the full export. Include manifest with sha256 for every object. Revoke grants after the window.

ops-bot: System note: CloudTrail captures KMS API events (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt). Events forwarded to Splunk index "kms_audit". Retention default 90d hot / 365d cold. For >365d file INF-RETENTION ticket.

jack: No permanent IAM roles for assessors. Use ephemeral STS + session tags. Example minimal S3 policy we can hand to assessors:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:ListBucket", "s3:GetObject"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-assessment-bundle/*"]
    }
  ]
}
```

sam: For KMS, prefer issuing grants rather than sharing key material. We'll log grant creation and revocation steps in the playbook. Example revoke command: 

```bash
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/assessment-key --grant-id <grant-id>
```

eva: Bundle checklist (keeps it short): full CloudTrail export (48h+), kube-audit logs, app worker logs (48h), snapshot of metrics (last 24h), manifest with sha256s. Also include instructions for verifying hashes.

maria: Who owns retest verification? Need someone to ack fixes, confirm logs present, verify KMS usage entries. Jack primary, Sam fallback?

jack: I'll be primary. I'll create a triage board with columns: reported -> in-progress -> fixed -> verified -> retest-scheduled. Verification checklist will include fix validation, log presence, and KMS event entries.

sam: I'll update vendor SLA to include 72h P1, communication cadence, and rollback notifications. Also add a clause for auto-fallback to a lower-capacity region if latency spikes during assessment.

maria: Actions recap: 1) sam: contract + rollback playbook. 2) eva: evidence bundle + presign + revoke instructions. 3) jack: triage board + retest checklist. 4) ops: confirm CloudTrail -> SIEM forwarding and retention. Dry-run scheduled Fri 09:00 UTC. I'll DM the vendor to confirm acceptance. :thumbsup:

eva: I'll post the presign generation and verification commands in the playbook before Friday.

jack: Will share triage board link here once created and send calendar invite for dry-run.

maria: Thanks all — we'll use this thread for playbook iteration and handoff notes.
